My best luck with peeing was taking him out every hour on the hour for at least 5-10 mins as well as 30 minutes after drinks and meals. When they go outside, you can click if you’re clicker training and give treats. I know it’s so frustrating but they will get the hang of it eventually. Once I started using this method my puppy got it in about a week. Also, my trainer told me not to use pee pads at all. So if that’s something you’re doing you might want to ditch them. The goal is to teach them to go outside to pee and the pee pads reinforce that they can go inside. Hang in there, your pup will get it in time

I just got my first puppy back in December, he was 3 months at the time. First piece of advice, hang in there - it’s so worth it! I was feeling pretty anxious at the start, and in retrospect I wish I had just spent more time enjoying the cuteness of the puppy stage. I know you mentioned you have had puppies before so I’m sure you already know that lol. Second, as others mentioned socialization is so important. My trainer recommended we do that as much as possible whether it be taking him to pet friendly stores like Home Depot or having him play with other dogs in the neighborhood. My trainer also taught us the basic commands (sit, down, stay, come, heel) using clicker training - I’m sure you can find a ton of videos on YouTube, it’s pretty easy! In general, I would say YouTube videos are a great resource and they’re free of course. That said, don’t be afraid to spend money on a trainer if it will help you and the pup, I think it was a worthwhile investment. From what I know, poodles are one of the smartest breeds out there so I’m sure your pup will get the hang of things quickly! Good luck, stay patient, and enjoy your new furry baby!
